index.title: AI-gile: dty phossan AI, er un bord
index.description: Ta AI-gile bord kanban son possanyn coadaghey AI. T'ad obbraghey choud as t'ou 'sy ruggyr; t'ou geddyn un chrink veg jeh reddyn dy hoiggal, dy hoiaghey as dy ghoaill rish.
hero.alphaTitle: Toshiagh as neu-hie: gura mie ayd son y hoiaghey!
hero.lede: T'ad troggal choud as t'ou 'sy ruggyr. T'ou dooyrt lesh un chrink veg: paartey dy ghoghyn, paartey dy reddyn dy hoiaghey, jeh diamond ghoair ny daa. Cliklee, gow rish, as ass lesh dty chaffee.
dl.notify: 🔔 Insh dou tra vees eh foshlit
hero.secondary: Agile, agh cha vel feme ec y phossan er caffee 'sy stadjey. (Ta'd jannoo ny stand-ups ny lomarcan.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile ayns cha mennick focklyn as te baare lhiat
pitch.lede: Reih lhiurid, veih un ockle gys 144. Ta gagh lhiurid e ard-ghoo hene, screeuit son yn eaghtyr shen. Tayrn y slider ny ymmyd ny kay-keayn.
f.pile.html: Ta Dhyts freayll dy chooilley nhee ta fieau ort, trooid dy chooilley phryjeck: fyssyn, reddyn dy hoiaghey, obbyr nagh vod agh dooinney y yannoo. Ta dty heshaght gra cre ta ny lurg as kys liurid ta eh goll dy ghoaill.
f.sleep.h: Possanyn ta obbraghey choud as t'ou 'sy ruggyr
f.sleep.p: Ta leeideilagh as possan jeh jaagenyn AI ec dy chooilley phryjeck. Screeu gaghlin er cart as ta'n possan doostey, jannoo yn obbyr, as cur eh back lesh kemmeeyn oddys dooinney skee leeideil.
f.tester.h: Ta tester AI jeeaghyn ec toshiaght
f.tester.p: Roish my jig red erbee dty hioree, ta tester geaishtagh ny kemmeeyn ayns coip jeh'n appey as soilshaghey cre honnick eh, lesh screenshot. Jeeagh er ny deaisht as gow rish ayns un chliklee.
f.proof.p: Ta dy chooilley chur-trooid soilshaghey cre ta caghlaait: ny coadanyn, y diff, ny screenshots. Cha vel ymmyd dy hoshlit dy chooilley appey dy akin my ta eh jeant.
f.chat.p: Rail goll rish Discord: un ikon son dy chooilley phryjeck, diamondyn ghoair son ny ta feme orrin. Cur screeuyn gys leeideilagh lesh smooinaght; ta eh cur eh ayns cartyn as plaan, lesh cliklee ✅ Go.
f.tidy.h: Ta eh freayll eh hene aarloo
f.tidy.p: Ta cartyn giarrey cheet cooidjagh ayns un, ta ennymyn ghoill er nyn gerraghey, as ta shilley tokenyn freayll yn coad caol. Ny sloo dy reddyn dy chlaghey, ny sloo dy smooinaghtyn.
f.private.li1: Ta'n bord roie er dty vashin hene as cha vel eh freggyrt agh dhyts.
f.private.li2: Ta DMyn pryveyt eddyr pobble enmyssit veih kione gys kione.
f.private.li3: Cha vel coontyn, cha vel trackeryn, cha vel cookies ayn.
f.lang.p: Erskyn 120 chengey, veih Ollanish, Bretnish as Yapaanish gys pirat, Yoda as Klingon, lesh caghlaa tappee back gys Baarle son focklyn ny ymmydeyryn.
f.service.p: Hrog oo red ennagh lesh AI ta pobble nish jannoo ymmyd jeh? Cowr eh myr service as nee yn boayrd cooney lhiat dy reaghey eh dy mie: prowallyn uptime, duillag status phublick, incidents lesh coontey screeuit, caghlaaghyn ta feme er Go, coipyn-sauchys prowit dagh laa. Ta Cooney ynsaghey dagh kesmad dhyt myr t’ou goll.
tl.aria: Linney traa veih'n chied resooney gys y vapp-raad
tl.h2: Veih'n chied resooney gys ny ta ry-heet
tl.lede: Laghyn as tiaghyn firrinagh, ayns dty chroo-traa hene. Lurg jiu, te plaan, gyn laa erbee gialdit.
join.lede: Ta AI-gile ta troggit liorish dooinney beg as earroo vooar jeh jaagenyn foiljagh. Te pryveyt nish, ayns alpha dooint rish carryn. Vel oo gearree eh y hoiaghey tra vees eh foshlit?
join.small: Nee mayd screeu er-ash dhyts, cha nhee elley

privacy.sealed: Te sealit myr nagh vod yn shirveishagh ain lhaih eh: ayns dty vrawseyr roish my faagys eh (er brawseyr ny shinney, cha leah's roshys eh). Cha vod agh yn bord ain hene fosley eh.

privacy.local: Ta dty hengey as dty reih soilshey ny dorraghey fuirraghtyn ayns dty vrawseyr hene. Cha vel ad rieau currit dooin.
